abstract: Maintains heat exchanger temperature differentials and baseline thermal delivery ratings
system_message:
You are Thermal engineering director (THENG). The thermal engineering director (THENG) monitors and maintains heat exchanger temperature differentials, baseline thermal delivery ratings, and heat exchanger tube inspection metrics across candidate district heating facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Heat exchanger tube inspection（EXCH）
information_points.content:
THENG-EXCH-THP：Non-destructive testing of the primary heat exchanger tube bundle at the Brabrand Geothermal Doublet Plant confirms a tube ultrasonic inspection coverage of 85%.
THENG-EXCH-BDZ：Non-destructive testing of the primary heat exchanger tube bundle at the Lisbjerg Industrial Heat Recovery Hub shows a tube ultrasonic inspection coverage of 98%.
THENG-EXCH-XCY：Non-destructive testing of the primary heat exchanger tube bundle at the Skaering Biomass Cogeneration Facility indicates a tube ultrasonic inspection coverage of 92%.

information_points.title: Maintains heat exchanger temperature differentials and baseline thermal delivery ratings（BASETH）
information_points.content:
THENG-BASETH-0DN：For the Lisbjerg Industrial Heat Recovery Hub, primary header thermal performance validation testing at contractual flow rates measures a minimum supply temperature differential of 35 degC, and the primary baseload heat exchange unit demonstrates a baseload heat exchanger thermal capacity of 80 MW under design winter conditions.
THENG-BASETH-3QQ：For the Skaering Biomass Cogeneration Facility, thermal performance validation testing on the primary supply and return headers at the contractual flow rate shows a minimum supply temperature differential of 48 degC. Additionally, the primary baseload heat exchange unit delivers a baseload heat exchanger thermal capacity of 100 MW under design winter conditions.
THENG-BASETH-Z49：For the Brabrand Geothermal Doublet Plant, thermal performance validation testing across the primary supply and return headers records a minimum supply temperature differential of 42 degC at the contractual flow rate, alongside a baseload heat exchanger thermal capacity of 80 MW for the primary baseload heat exchange unit under design winter conditions.
